target_customer: Institutional and sophisticated investors wanting exposure to public company KPIs such as revenue and earnings without equity risk
problem: Investors with views on a company's fundamentals could only express them through the stock, which carries market risk. Fluid planned futures on individual KPIs.
business_model: Exchange taking fees on KPI futures contracts, pending regulatory approval
product_category: Financial exchange for KPI futures and event contracts

founders.name: Ken Book
prior_employers: Goldman Sachs or Barclays (YC launch post states the three founders worked in derivatives and securitization at these banks, individual split not given)
previous_startups: Pointwise (credit card recommendation app, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Described as CEO and founder in a podcast listing.

founders.name: Benjamin Litvin
founders.background_notes: Author of the YC launch post. A third founder named Ari is mentioned there without a surname.

exit.reason: Company site states Fluid is no longer operating and points users to Kalshi and Polymarket; no cause given.

technical_complexity.rationale: A paper trading beta is buildable by a small team, but a real exchange needs clearing, market making and regulatory approval.

defensibility.rationale: A regulatory license would be a moat, but the company was still awaiting approval in its launch materials and had no network liquidity.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Prediction market leaders grew massively later; the company closed and its site now redirects users to them.

market_need_then: Demand was untested; the beta was a paper trading competition with cash prizes while regulatory approval was pending, so real paying demand is not evidenced.

branding.domain_note: Operated at fluidinvesting.com rather than an exact match domain.
branding.community_and_virality: A podcast episode and Product Hunt beta listing only; search results are crowded with unrelated crypto products named Fluid.

brand_strength.rationale: Little press and a generic name that collides with unrelated Fluid crypto products.

outcome_analysis: Fluid Markets tried to launch futures on public company KPIs, a model resembling prediction markets, but sources show only a paper trading beta awaiting regulatory approval. The company site says it is no longer operating; the cause is not public. Regulatory delay and funding are plausible but unconfirmed, so failure factors are tentative inferences from the pending approval language.
notes: Directory status says Active but the company site says it is no longer operating, so exit is shutdown with unknown date. The cause of shutdown is not public in sources found; failure factors are inferred from the pending regulatory approval and are low confidence. Funding: CB Insights shows 500K convertible note and VCBacked shows 1.2M total, both unverified aggregator figures with no second source, so no round is recorded. Competitor searches returned only 2025 and 2026 prediction market coverage, so none dated near founding. Completeness pass: a convertible note of 500K in 2023 is recorded from CB Insights alone. VCBacked instead reports 1.2M total, April 2023, pre-seed; the gap is unresolved. Investors not stated.
